proof_body:
by
  intro R M _ _ _ _ _ _
  let T := Submodule.torsion R M
  haveI : Module.Free R (M ⧸ T) := by
    haveI : Module.IsTorsionFree R (M ⧸ T) := inferInstance
    exact Module.free_of_finite_type_torsion_free'
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (T.mkQ).exists_rightInverse_of_surjective (Submodule.range_mkQ T)
  have hinj : Function.Injective s := fun a b h => by
    have := congrArg T.mkQ h
    simpa [← LinearMap.comp_apply, hs] using this
  refine ⟨LinearMap.range s, ?_, Module.Free.of_equiv (LinearEquiv.ofInjective s hinj)⟩
  constructor
  · rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    rintro x hx ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have h1 : y = T.mkQ (s y) := (LinearMap.congr_fun hs y).symm
    have h2 : T.mkQ (s y) = 0 := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero T).2 hx
    rw [h1, h2, map_zero]
  · rw [codisjoint_iff, eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    have e : x = (x - s (T.mkQ x)) + s (T.mkQ x) := by abel
    rw [e]
    refine Submodule.add_mem_sup ?_ ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero T]
    have h1 : T.mkQ (s (T.mkQ x)) = T.mkQ x := LinearMap.congr_fun hs _
    change T.mkQ _ = 0
    rw [map_sub, h1, sub_self]
target_source: ∀ (R M : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M], ∃ F : Submodule R M, IsCompl (Submodule.torsion R M) F ∧ Module.Free R F
